name: html lang attribute matches the selected locale
description: The document's <html lang> attribute must reflect the active locale: lang="en" on /en pages, lang="es" on /es pages, lang="pt" on /pt pages. A skeleton that hard-codes lang="en" everywhere fails this test and breaks screen-reader pronunciation.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /en and read the lang attribute of the root <html> element
Navigate to /es and read the lang attribute of the root <html> element
Navigate to /pt and read the lang attribute of the root <html> element
Verify <html lang> is "en" on the /en page, "es" on the /es page, and "pt" on the /pt page. If the lang attribute is identical (e.g. always "en") across locales or missing, the test fails.
